scientific_integrity: The geometric Igusa configuration, its S6 action and twisting are established prior work. The assessed result is the exact zeta function of the reduced singular curve for all sextic trace twists, not of the ambient quartic. The proof includes an explicit characteristic >= 7 geometric singular-locus argument, normalization formula, all eleven group actions and a reproducible exact verifier. No external independent scientific audit was performed.
scientific_limitations: Reduced singular curves, not the nonreduced singular subscheme
Historical priority is qualified by implicit derivability from classical S6 actions and incompletely examined older literature
title: The singular-curve zeta functions of all sextic trace twists of the Igusa quartic
